description: Probabilistic seismic response and capacity models of piles for statewide bridges in California is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Yazhou Xie, Rice University (rice.edu). The R5P pile response models are the output datafile associated with the following publication. Xie, Y., Zheng, Q., Roblee, C., Yang, CSW., Padgett, J.,and R. DesRoches. (2020) “Probabilistic seismic response and capacity models of piles for statewide bridges in California.” ASCE J. Struct.Eng. (forthcoming). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: pile foundations; state pile inventory; seismic response models; California bridges; concrete and steel piles.. Published 2020-10-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
